raw.title: Google's New Gemini 4 Neon Joins Gemini 4 Argon at the Top of the DualEntry Accounting AI
raw.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Google's newly released Gemini 4 Neon got 91.1% of accounting tasks right on the DualEntry Accounting AI Benchmark, tying Google's Gemini 4 Argon for the highest score among 29 leading AI models tested. Neon beat Argon on bank reconciliation (91.7% vs 75%) and on hard tasks (85.7% vs 82.1%). Argon was slightly more consistent (86.1% vs 85.1%) and cheaper per task. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is tied for third at 88.1% with Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3 Flash and SpaceXAI's Grok 4.7.

raw.title: Celldex Reports Results from Phase 2 Study of Barzolvolimab in Atopic Dermatitis
raw.text: HAMPTON, N.J., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Celldex (NASDAQ:CLDX) today reported topline results from the Company's Phase 2 study of barzolvolimab in moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (AD). Barzolvolimab, a first-in-class humanized monoclonal antibody with a novel mechanism of action that uniquely targets the KIT receptor and depletes mast cells, is being studied across multiple indications where mast cells are implicated in the disease pathology. The primary endpoint of the Phase 2 AD study, the percent change from baseline in the weekly average of the daily Peak Pruritus Numerical Rating Scale (PP-NRS) score at Week 16 compared to placebo, and key secondary endpoints were not met. While some benefit from barzolvolimab treatment was observed, these improvements did not meet the Company's internal hurdle rate for continued development. Data suggest that while mast cells contribute to AD, they are not a primary driver of the disease. Based on these results, Celldex is discontinuing development in AD. Consistent with previously reported studies, barzolvolimab demonstrated a favorable safety and tolerability profile.

raw.title: Invivyd Announces Positive DECLARATION Trial Data for Monoclonal Antibody VYD2311, and Ushers in a New Era for Immunization
raw.text: NEW HAVEN, Conn., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Invivyd, Inc. (Nasdaq: IVVD) today announced all interim analysis primary and secondary endpoints were met in the DECLARATION Phase 3 trial of VYD2311 (ibramvibart). VYD2311, administered via intramuscular injection (IM), demonstrated high and durable antiviral activity, consistent with Invivyd's target 70-90% protection from RT-PCR confirmed symptomatic COVID-19, versus placebo. VYD2311 demonstrated an overall highly attractive safety and tolerability profile in both single- and multi-dose arms. Invivyd intends to submit a Biologics License Application (BLA) seeking accelerated approval of VYD2311 for the prevention of symptomatic COVID-19 based on the positive interim analysis of the Phase 3 DECLARATION trial and the supportive data from the Phase 3 LIBERTY trial comparing VYD2311 and an mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccine.

(Nasdaq: SLS) (“SELLAS” or the “Company”), a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel therapies for a broad range of cancer indications, today announced the closing of its previously announced underwritten public offering of 13,269,231 shares of its common stock at a public offering price of $13.00 per share, which includes the exercise in full by the underwriters of their option to purchase 1,730,769 additional shares of common stock. Investors in the offering included new healthcare-focused institutional investors.

raw.title: SELLAS Life Sciences Announces Pricing of $150.0 Million Underwritten Public Offering

(Nasdaq: SLS) (“SELLAS” or the “Company”), a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel therapies for a broad range of cancer indications, today announced the pricing of its previously announced underwritten public offering of 11,538,462 shares of its common stock at a public offering price of $13.00 per share. All of the shares in the offering will be sold by SELLAS, with gross proceeds to SELLAS expected to be $150.0 million before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and offering expenses. In addition, SELLAS has also granted the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 1,730,769 additional shares of its common stock at the public offering price, less underwriting discounts and commissions. The offering is expected to close on November 20, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.

raw.title: Immuneering to Present at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference
raw.text: NEW YORK, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX), a late-stage clinical oncology company focused on keeping cancer patients alive and helping them thrive, today announced that management will present at the Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference in New York City on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 4:00 pm ET. The presentation will be webcast live and archived in the Investor Relations section of Immuneering's website at Events & Presentations | Immuneering Corporation.

raw.title: Immuneering Presents Additional Data Demonstrating Atebimetinib's Broad Potential as a Backbone for Combination Therapy in Pancreatic Cancer
raw.text: - Atebimetinib in combination with chemotherapies has shown excellent results in Phase 2, including long survival and an outstanding tolerability profile in an all-comers population of first-line pancreatic cancer patients treated with atebimetinib + mGnP, as presented in June at ASCO - - Atebimetinib in combination with CLDN18.2-targeted agents will be evaluated in two clinical trials in recently announced collaboration with Astellas - - Atebimetinib in combination with PRMT5 inhibitors, KRAS G12V inhibitors, and KRAS G12D inhibitors demonstrated synergistic activity in preclinical data presented at the 2026 EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium - - Atebimetinb in combination with chemotherapy is currently being evaluated in Phase 3 MAPKeeper 301 trial in an all-comers population of first-line pancreatic cancer patients - NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX), a late-stage clinical oncology company focused on keeping cancer patients alive and helping them thrive, today presented new preclinical data demonstrating the potential of atebimetinib to serve as a backbone for combinations with multiple classes of anticancer agents. The findings, generated using both animal models and three-dimensional (3D) tumor models of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), identify multiple synergistic combination strategies and provide further support for atebimetinib's potential to play a central role as a MAPK pathway backbone for combinations in pancreatic cancer and beyond.

raw.title: Immuneering Presents Data That Supports Expanding the Clinical Evaluation of Atebimetinib to Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer
raw.text: - Atebimetinib has already reported compelling Phase 2 clinical data in first-line pancreatic cancer, is currently being evaluated in a Phase 3 trial in first-line pancreatic cancer, and will soon begin a Phase 2 trial in first-line RAS-mutant lung cancer - - Atebimetinib demonstrated anti-tumor activity across all nine anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC) cell lines evaluated, including BRAF V600E-mutant, RAS-mutant and MAPK-unaltered, in data presented at the 2026 EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium - - Atebimetinib in combination with chemotherapy demonstrated better tumor control than either chemotherapy alone or dabrafenib + trametinib in an animal model of BRAF V600E-mutant ATC, supporting planned Phase 2 trial in second-line ATC patients - NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Immuneering Corporation (Nasdaq: IMRX), a late-stage clinical oncology company focused on keeping cancer patients alive and helping them thrive, today announced compelling preclinical data that supports expanding the clinical development of atebimetinib, its investigational deep cyclic MEK inhibitor, to a third tumor type: anaplastic thyroid cancer (ATC). The findings were presented at the 38th EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics in Barcelona, Spain.

(Nasdaq: RWAY) (“Runway Growth” or the “Company”), a leading provider of flexible capital solutions to late- and growth-stage companies seeking an alternative to raising equity, today announced that it intends to redeem all of its remaining 7.50% Notes due 2027 (CUSIP No. 78163D 209; NasdaqGS: RWAYL) (the “Notes”). The Company expects to redeem $40,250,000 aggregate principal amount of the issued and outstanding Notes on December 29, 2026 (the “Redemption Date”). The redemption price per Note will be $25 plus accrued and unpaid interest thereon from December 1, 2026 to, but excluding, the Redemption Date.

raw.title: Oatly Stock Surges 104%: What's Happening?
raw.text: Oatly Group AB (NASDAQ:OTLY) shares are surging on Monday after the company's board urged shareholders not to tender their shares into Verlinvest's offer. Here's what investors need to know.

raw.title: Oatly Board Recommends Shareholders Not Tender Their Shares or ADSs In Verlinvest's Tender Offer
raw.text: Oatly Board Recommends Shareholders Not Tender Their Shares or ADSs In Verlinvest's Tender Offer The Disinterested Directors of Oatly's Board Unanimously Recommend Oatly Shareholders Not to Tender Their Ordinary Shares or ADSs, Consistent with Verlinvest's Stated Position in its Offer to Purchase Oatly Welcomes Verlinvest's Decision to Increase Its Investment and Continued Long-Term Commitment MALMÖ, Sweden, November 23, 2026 – Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY), the world's original and largest oat drink company (“Oatly”), announced today that, after careful consideration, including review of the terms and conditions of the tender offer (the “Offer”) by Verlinvest S.A. (“Verlinvest”) in consultation with Oatly's management and legal advisors, the disinterested directors of Oatly's board of directors (the “Oatly Board”) unanimously determined that the Offer is not in the best interests of Oatly's shareholders.

raw.text: Oatly Confirms Commencement of Tender Offer by Verlinvest The Disinterested Directors of the Oatly Board are Evaluating the Tender Offer and Urge Securityholders Not to Take Action at This Time MALMÖ, Sweden, November 20, 2026 – Oatly Group AB (publ) (Nasdaq: OTLY), the world's original and largest oat drink company (“Oatly”), today confirmed that Verlinvest S.A. (“Verlinvest”) has commenced a tender offer to acquire all of the outstanding (i) ordinary shares of Oatly (“Ordinary Shares”) for $0.2065 per Ordinary Share in cash and (ii) American depositary shares (“ADSs”) of Oatly, each representing twenty Ordinary Shares, for $4.13 per ADS in cash.

raw.text: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Allogene Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALLO), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of allogeneic CAR T (AlloCAR T) products for cancer and autoimmune disease, today announced its participation in the 68th American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting and Exposition in New Orleans. Allogene's activities at ASH will highlight the potential of allogeneic CAR T to expand patient access through new physician market research and expert discussions on barriers to treatment. Additionally, the Company's pivotal ALPHA3 trial, evaluating cemacabtagene ansegedleucel (cema-cel) as minimal residual disease (MRD)-guided first-line consolidation therapy for patients with large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL), will be featured at a clinical trial showcase hosted by Natera.

raw.text: DENVER, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pure Cycle Corporation (NASDAQ Capital Market: PCYO) (“Pure Cycle”, the “Company”, “we”, “us” or “our”) announced its financial results for the year ended August 31, 2026. Lot sales revenue increased 45% on accelerated development activity at Sky Ranch, water and wastewater segment revenue increased 30% on higher water sales to oil and gas operators, and single-family rental revenue increased 73% as we placed 36 additional rental homes in service. Operating income increased 75% to $13.4 million, which more than offset a $4.7 million decrease in oil and gas royalty income. Pure Cycle reported $14.2 million of net income, or $0.59 per fully diluted common share, each a 9% increase from 2025, marking our ninth consecutive profitable fiscal year and twenty-ninth consecutive fiscal quarter with positive net income. Our diversified water and land platform was on full display this year, as steady, annual-cadence lot deliveries to our national homebuilder partners were complemented by a sharp increase in water sales to oil and gas operators.

raw.title: Actuate Therapeutics Reports Positive Monotherapy Data in Aggressive Melanoma Preclinical Model with Daily Dosing of Elraglusib Oral Tablet at ENA 2026
raw.text: Daily oral elraglusib achieved up to 77% tumor growth inhibition as monotherapy in an aggressive preclinical melanoma model, with greater antitumor activity observed at higher drug exposures Treatment was associated with changes in the tumor immune microenvironment, characterized by increased cytotoxic T cells and natural killer cells and reduced immunosuppressive myeloid cells Findings further reinforce initiation of Phase 1/2 clinical trial in Q1 2027 with daily dosing of elraglusib oral tablet CHICAGO and FORT WORTH, Texas, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Actuate Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACTU) (“Actuate” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing therapies for difficult-to-treat cancers, today announced new preclinical data demonstrating that daily oral administration of elraglusib achieved up to 77% tumor growth inhibition as monotherapy in an aggressive melanoma model, with greater antitumor activity associated with increased drug exposure. The findings, presented at the 38th EORTC-NCI-AACR Symposium on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics (ENA 2026), also demonstrated changes in the tumor immune microenvironment consistent with enhanced antitumor immune activity, supporting the continued development of Elraglusib Oral Tablet in the upcoming Phase 1/2 clinical trial to be initiated in the first quarter of 2027.

raw.text: November 18, 2026, ST. PETERSBURG, FL – Water Tower Research (www.watertowerresearch.com) will host its inaugural WTR Forum Series event, “CLEAN AIR AND WATER: Feedstock, Filtration, and PFAS Solutions,” on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 9:00 am ET. Companies invited include Arq, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQ), BP Polymers (private), Clinch Resources Ltd. (TSX: CLCH), and Ingevity Corporation (NYSE: NGVT). The virtual event offers investors direct access to senior management through executive fireside chats, company management presentations, and curated one-on-one meetings. Registration is open here. The WTR Forum Series convenes companies, senior management, and expert speakers around a theme that matters to investors. This event follows the clean air and water value chain, from specialty carbon feedstocks, to the activated carbon that removes PFAS and mercury from water and captures fuel vapor in vehicles, to packaging that prevents PFAS at the source. Sessions will cover regulation as a demand driver, feedstock security and critical minerals designations, activated carbon supply and pricing, capital-light PFAS treatment, clean air through the hybrid vehicle transition, barrier alternatives to fluorinated plastic containers, and what to watch into 2027.

raw.text: Cootamundra, Australia, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Australian Oilseeds Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: COOT) (the “Company”) today announced that it received a notification letter dated November 17, 2026 (the “Notice”) from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) notifying the Company that it is not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) (the “Equity Rule”), which requires listed companies to maintain stockholders' equity of at least $2,500,000. The Annual Report presents the Company's financial statements in Australian dollars and reported a total deficit of AUD 6,335,275 as of June 30, 2026.

raw.text: Dublin, Ireland, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fusion Fuel Green PLC (Nasdaq: HTOO) (“Fusion Fuel” or the “Company”), a diversified energy platform, today announced that it is evaluating potential investment opportunities in Venezuela, with an initial focus on energy, natural resources and related infrastructure. Through its subsidiary Royal Uranium Inc. (“Royal Uranium”), the Company already holds a portfolio of uranium and natural gas royalty and other interests. In Venezuela, the Company is exploring potential royalty interests, joint ventures or other commercial arrangements, and acquisitions. Management believes that Venezuela's resource base, increasing oil production and evolving investment framework may create long-term investment opportunities.

raw.title: Renforth Completes Updated Mineral Resource Estimate On Wholly Owned Parbec Gold Deposit In Malartic, Quebec
raw.text: TORONTO, Ontario — November 18, 2026 – TheNewswire —  Renforth Resources Inc. (CSE: RFR | OTC: RFHRF | FSE: 9RR) ("Renforth" or the "Company") is pleased to advise shareholders that P&E Mining Consultants Inc. (“P&E”) have completed an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) on the Company's wholly owned Parbec Gold Deposit in Malartic, Quebec, located on the Cadillac Break and contiguous to Agnico Eagle's Canadian Malartic Mine Property.  The updated MRE, stated below, is comprised of a pit constrained, Indicated Mineral Resource of 168,700 ounces of gold grading 1.10 g/t contained within 4.77 million tonnes and an additional pit constrained Inferred Mineral Resource of 192,900 ounces of gold grading 1.22 g/t Au contained within 4.91 million tonnes. There is also an out of pit (underground) Inferred Mineral Resource of 74,200 ounces of gold, grading 1.79 g/t Au contained within 1.29 million tonnes. The total Mineral Resource presented by P&E, effective November 17, 2026, is 168,700 Indicated ounces of gold and 267,000 Inferred ounces of gold with the assumptions and considerations stated below. This represents an overall increase to the prior April 2025 MRE for Parbec, however, it does not trigger the requirement to file another Technical Report. As previously announced on Nov. 12, 2026, Renforth has retained P&E to commence overseeing metallurgical testwork on Parbec mineralization which is designed to support a Preliminary Economic Assessment in 2027.   “I am pleased to deliver this Mineral Resource increase, for our Parbec Gold Deposit to shareholders at this time, however, at the same time I want to emphasize that our work at Parbec is ongoing. We are awaiting results from the additional channels cut within the open pit footprint announced last week and will be working to establish the metallurgical characteristics of the Deposit. Additionally, we are permitted for a significant amount of drilling in the next two years. Today's announcement makes our Mineral Resource current, in terms of gold price and the inclusion of all our completed exploration work. We will continue to move forward from here” states Nicole Brewster, President and CEO of Renforth.

raw.text: VANCOUVER, B.C., November 25, 2026 – TheNewswire - Inverite Insights Inc. ("Inverite") (CSE: INVR) (OTC: INVRF) (FSE: 2V0), a Canadian risk infrastructure company providing real-time financial data and decisioning signals, specializing in real-time bank verification, income and affordability analytics, and AI-driven risk-modeling and fraud-prevention solutions used by fintechs, lenders, and financial institutions across Canada, today welcomed the Government of Canada's designation of Financial Data Exchange ("FDX") as the technical standards body and the Ombudsman for Banking Services and Investments ("OBSI") as the external complaints body under Canada's Consumer-Driven Banking Framework, as announced by the Department of Finance Canada on November 20, 2026. The designations were announced by the Honourable François-Philippe Champagne, Minister of Finance and National Revenue, and the ministerial orders were published in Canada Gazette, Part I. FDX will develop and maintain the technical standard for secure, interoperable data sharing between participating entities, including common data definitions and protocols for secure communication. Under a made-in-Canada approach, FDX has established a Canada Council that can make decisions independently of the broader FDX Board, with voting membership limited to Canadian residents and businesses. OBSI, designated in 2023 as the sole external complaints body for banks, will independently investigate consumer-driven banking complaints that participating entities have not resolved and recommend resolutions.

Companies invited include Arq, Inc. (NASDAQ: ARQ), BP Polymers (private), Clinch Resources Ltd. (TSX: CLCH), and Ingevity Corporation (NYSE: NGVT). The virtual event offers investors direct access to senior management through executive fireside chats, company management presentations, and curated one-on-one meetings. Registration is open here. The WTR Forum Series convenes companies, senior management, and expert speakers around a theme that matters to investors. This event follows the clean air and water value chain, from specialty carbon feedstocks, to the activated carbon that removes PFAS and mercury from water and captures fuel vapor in vehicles, to packaging that prevents PFAS at the source. Sessions will cover regulation as a demand driver, feedstock security and critical minerals designations, activated carbon supply and pricing, capital-light PFAS treatment, clean air through the hybrid vehicle transition, barrier alternatives to fluorinated plastic containers, and what to watch into 2027.

raw.title: LaFleur Minerals Secures Strategic Investment of up to C$4.3 Million via Non-Brokered Private Placement
raw.text: Single arm's-length strategic investor to subscribe at C$0.335 per share, with no finder's fees; proceeds to support commissioning and ramp-up of the 100%-owned, fully permitted Beacon Gold Mill as drilling continues to expand the Swanson Gold Deposit Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 25, 2026) - LaFleur Minerals Inc. (CSE: LFLR) (OTCQB: LFLRF) (FSE: 3WK0) ("LaFleur Minerals" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that a strategic investor (the "Investor") has agreed to subscribe for up to 12,870,102 common shares of the Company (each, a "Common Share", and the Common Shares so issued, the "Offered Shares") at a price of C$0.335 per Offered Share (the "Offering Price") for gross proceeds of up to approximately C$4,311,484, by way of a non-brokered private placement (the "Private Placement"). raw.title: Zoom Communications: The Core Business Trades At Just 9x FCF, With Anthropic Upside On Top
raw.text: Zoom Communications remains a strong buy; its core trades at roughly 9x free cash flow, with upside from its Anthropic stake on top. ZM's enterprise revenue growth accelerated to 8.6% in Q3 FY27, while expanding margins and 23% growth in non-current RPO support the platform thesis. ZM's $7.29 billion cash and securities position and my estimated $3.83 billion Anthropic stake underpin flexibility for investment, buybacks and its new dividend.

raw.title: GE Vernova: The FCF Jump Makes It A Strong Buy
raw.text: I am reiterating a Strong Buy on GE Vernova with a $957 price target. GEV's Q3 2026 revenue rose 27% to $12.6 billion, while the adjusted EBITDA margin reached 15.4%, and free cash flow increased to $5.4 billion. GEV's ~$200 billion backlog provides a 5-year revenue visibility. The planned Trench acquisition is also expected to add $1.9 billion in 2028 revenue.

raw.title: Chord Energy: A 15% FCF Yield At $75 Oil And A Shrinking Share Count, Buy
raw.text: Chord reported a Q3 adjusted FCF of $442M and repurchased $205M in shares, supporting FCF per share growth. Oil production guidance increased for the second time in 2026, with management expecting stable production in 2027. Chord has only 0.2x net leverage, and the Marcellus sale could create more room for buybacks.

raw.text: DALLAS, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Argent Trust Company, as the trustee (the "Trustee") of the San Juan Basin Royalty Trust (the "Trust") (NYSE: SJT), today reported that it will not declare a monthly cash distribution to the holders of its units of beneficial interest (the "Unit Holders") due to excess production costs incurred during prior periods for the Trust's royalty interest burdening the subject interests ("Subject Interests"), as well as continued low natural gas pricing. Excess production costs occur when production costs and capital expenditures exceed the gross proceeds for a certain period.

raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - November 24, 2026 – AEON STRATEGIES LTD. (formerly Cloud3 Ventures Inc.) (CSE: AEON) (OTCQB: CLDVF) (FSE: WQ40) (the “ Company ” or “ Aeon ”) is providing this bi-weekly default status report, further to its news release dated November 10, 2026, under National Policy 12-203 – Management Cease Trade Orders (“ NP 12-203 ”). On October 23, 2026 and October 27, 2026, the Company announced that it expected to be unable to file its audited annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, the related management's discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certifications (collectively, the “ Annual Filings ”) by the October 28, 2026 filing deadline.   On October 29, 2026, the Ontario Securities Commission, as principal regulator, issued a management cease trade order (the “ MCTO ”) under NP 12-203. The MCTO prohibits the Company's Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer from trading in or acquiring the Company's securities, directly or indirectly. It will remain in effect until two full business days after the Ontario Securities Commission receives all filings the Company is required to make under Ontario securities law, or until further order. The MCTO does not affect the ability of other shareholders to trade in the Company's securities.

raw.text: Century Lithium Corp. (TSX-V:LCE, OTCQX:CYDVF) said the US Bureau of Land Management has confirmed baseline studies are complete for its Angel Island lithium project in Nevada, clearing the way for a full environmental review.  The BLM also determined that an Environmental Impact Statement is the appropriate level of review under the National Environmental Policy Act, the company said.

raw.title: CENTURY LITHIUM RECEIVES NOTICE OF COMPLETION AND ACCEPTANCE OF BASELINE STUDIES FOR ANGEL ISLAND LITHIUM PROJECT, NEVADA USA
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Lithium Corp. (TSXV: LCE) (OTCQX: CYDVF) (Frankfurt: C1Z) ("Century Lithium" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the U.S. Bureau of Land Management ("BLM"), Battle Mountain District, Tonopah Field Office, has determined that baseline data collection and reporting are complete for the Company's 100%-owned Angel Island Lithium Project ("Angel Island" or the "Project") in Esmeralda County, Nevada, USA. The BLM has also determined that the appropriate National Environmental Policy Act ("NEPA") review level for the Project is an Environmental Impact Statement ("EIS").

recentNews.title: Golden Cariboo Advances Halo Zone Drilling as Step-Out Hole QGQ26-35 Exceeds 416 Metres

raw.title: Golden Cariboo Advances Halo Zone Drilling as Step-Out Hole QGQ26-35 Exceeds 416 Metres
raw.text: November 18, 2026 – TheNewswire - Vancouver, B.C., Canada – Golden Cariboo Resources Ltd. (the “Company”) (CSE:GCC) (OTC:GCCFF) (WKN:A402CQ) (FSE:3TZ) announce an update of exploration activities at its 100%-owned Quesnelle Gold Quartz Mine Property located about 50 km southeast of Prince George, near Hixon in central British Columbia. Drilling continues on step-out hole QGQ26-35, which has now reached beyond 416 metres (1,365 feet) depth while remaining within the favourable volcanic package that hosts much of the Halo z one mineralization (see map enclos ure or visit Company website ) . Importantly, the hole has not yet intersected the projected western greenstone-argillite contact, extending the target horizon significantly beyond initial projections and supporting continued evaluation of the southern extension of the Halo Deposit beyond the limits of the Company's current Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE").   Since completion of the Company's inaugural Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE"), drilling, sampling and regional exploration activities have continued to advance. Geological logging has been completed on holes QGQ26-31 (seen in the below photo) through QGQ26-34, which were drilled after the MRE cut-off date and are therefore not included in the current resource model. Core samples from QGQ26-32 have been received by MSA Labs in Prince George for PhotonAssay™ analysis, samples from QGQ26-31 are expected to be submitted later this week, and QGQ26-33 core is anticipated to be at the lab next week. Core logging of QGQ26-34 and 35 is in progress. Assay results will be released when available.

(OTCID: GCEI), an AI-powered resilience and sustainable-infrastructure company, today announces Flamelit's five-year anniversary of helping organizations move beyond AI experimentation and put artificial intelligence to work in daily operations. raw.title: Graycliff Announces Private Placement Offering
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 25, 2026) - Graycliff Exploration Limited (CSE: GRAY) (OTCQB: GRYCF) (FSE: GE0) ("Graycliff" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it intends to complete a non-brokered private placement financing, in one or more tranches, of: (i) up to 2,300,000 flow-through units of the Company (the "FT Units"), at a price of $0.18 per FT Unit, for gross proceeds of up to $414,000; and (ii) up to 2,000,000 non-flow-through, hard dollar units of the Company (the "HD Units"), at a price of $0.15 per HD Unit, for gross proceeds of up to $300,000 (the "Offering"). Each FT Unit and HD Unit (together, the "Units") will be comprised of one common share in the capital of the Company (each, a "Share") and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (each such whole warrant, a "Warrant"), with each Warrant entitling the holder to purchase one Share at a price of $0.25 for a period of one year from the closing date of the applicable tranche of the Offering.

raw.title: EV Metals 10, LLC Enters Into Term Sheet for Secured Credit Facility with International Battery Metals Ltd.
raw.text: SAN JUAN, Puerto Rico, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Jacob Warnock (“Mr. Warnock”) is pleased to announce that, on November 13, 2026, EV Metals 10, LLC, an entity controlled by Mr. Warnock, entered into a term sheet with International Battery Metals Ltd. (“IBAT”) (TSXV: IBAT) (OTCQB: IBATF) for a secured credit facility providing for a term loan of up to US$12.0 million, bearing interest at 10% per annum, maturing 18 months from execution, subject to an original issue discount of 5%, and secured by substantially all of the current and future assets and property of IBAT, with funding subject to the execution of definitive agreements and customary closing conditions. IBAT, based in Vancouver, British Columbia, is an advanced technology provider of modular direct lithium extraction systems. Mr. Warnock continues to beneficially own or control 143,641,569 common shares and 120,741,648 share purchase warrants of IBAT, representing approximately 57.01% of the issued and outstanding common shares on a partially-diluted basis, a securityholding percentage that is unchanged as a result of the term sheet, and Mr. Warnock holds such securities for investment purposes and may acquire further securities of IBAT, or dispose of securities of IBAT, as investment conditions warrant.

raw.title: Imperial Brands keeps Deutsche Bank ‘buy' despite lower target
raw.text: Imperial Brands PLC (LSE:IMB) retained its ‘buy' rating from Deutsche Bank, which cut its price target from 3,500 to 3,40p but still sees appeal in the group's cash generation and valuation. Deutsche Bank's Damian McNeela said concerns about market share losses were overdone given the interplay between share gains, profit delivery and cash generation.

raw.title: Imperial Brands: Another Solid But Unspectacular Year
raw.text: Imperial Brands remains a hold: after a 22% rally, valuation looks fair, not attractive, given cigarette declines and industry risks. IMBBY's 5.1% price increases offset a 3% tobacco volume decline, though pricing power will eventually reach its limits. The dividend rose 4%, with £1.3bn in payments covered by £2.6bn of free cash flow; £1.6bn of buybacks could be reduced.

recentNews.title: Edgewater Wireless Announces Completion of Additional Payments of Debenture Interest

raw.title: Edgewater Wireless Announces Completion of Additional Payments of Debenture Interest
raw.text: November 19, 2026 – Ottawa, Canada – TheNewswire - Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. (TSXV: YFI) (OTC: KPIFF) (“ Edgewater ” or the “ Company ”) announces that it has settled its obligation to pay an aggregate of $17,726.30 in interest as of December 1, 2025, $17,531.51 in interest as of March 1, 2026, $17,921.10 in interest as of June 1, 2026 and $17,921.10 in interest as of September 1, 2026 to the holders of its unsecured debentures issued September 1, 2022 (the “ Debentures ”) through the issuance of an aggregate of 1,421,982 common shares of the Company at a deemed price of $0.05 per share (the “ Shares ”). The Shares are issued in full satisfaction of the December 1, 2025, March 1, 2026, June 1, 2026 and September 1, 2026 interest payment obligations in accordance with the terms of the Debentures, and represents the 13 th to 16 th interest payments pursuant to the terms of the Debentures. The debt settlement has been approved by the TSX Venture Exchange.   Certain directors of the Company received an aggregate of 265,995 Shares and therefore the share issuance constitutes a “related party transaction” as that term is defined in Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions (“ MI 61-101 ”). The Company will rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 as neither the fair market value of the Shares nor the debt exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization .

raw.title: Laurion Announces Proposed Private Placement of Flow-Through Units
raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - November 25 , 2026 – LAURION Mineral Exploration Inc. (TSX.V: LME|OTC: LMEFF|FSE: 5YD) (“LAURION” or the “Corporation”) today announced that it is proposing to complete a flow-through private placement on a non-brokered basis (the “ Private Placement ”). The Corporation intends to raise up to approximately $ 1.5 million in gross proceeds by issuing up to approximately 14,285,714 “flow through” units (“ FT Units ”) at a price of $0.105 per FT Unit. Each FT Unit will consist of one common share of the Corporation to be issued as a “flow-through share” (as defined in subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the “ Tax Act ”)) and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (each whole warrant, a “ Warrant ”). Each Warrant will entitle the holder thereof to acquire one non flow-through common share of the Corporation at a price of $0.18 per share for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.

raw.text: REIT profitability metrics are a useful baseline, but business models and accounting subtleties demand company-specific analysis. Triple-net leases boost property-level margins, but interest expense can erode company-level profitability; low leverage and efficient corporate overhead support FFO margins. NOI relative to gross depreciable property generally offers the clearest view of asset profitability, though land holdings and accounting resets can distort it.

Under the Company's prior management during the period from 2021 to late 2024, the benefits program included a premium personal wellness component that permitted an unusually broad range of expenses, including purchases that fell outside the conventional scope of health and wellness benefits, including a high-end road bicycle purchased by Justin Cochrane, former CEO, valued at approximately C$12,400, of which approximately C$9,700 was reimbursed by the Company under the wellness program.

raw.text: Update Outlines M&I Resources of 2.15 Billion tonnes at 0.25% Cu and Inferred Resources of 971 Million tonnes at 0.45% Cu MONTREAL, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Osisko Metals Incorporated (the “Company” or “Osisko Metals”) ( TSX: OM ; OTCQX: OMZNF ; FRANKFURT: 0B51 ) is pleased to announce an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) for the Gaspé Copper Project, located in the Gaspé peninsula of Eastern Quebec. raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia – November 25, 2026 - TheNewswire – Opawica Explorations Inc. (the “Company” or “Opawica”) (TSXV: OPW) (OTCQB: OPWEF) announces that it has closed the first tranche of its non-brokered private placement and raised $2,160,000 through the issuance of 10,941,178 flow through common shares (“FT Shares”) at a price of $0.17 per FT Share and 1,999,999 non-flow through units (“NFT Units”) at a price of $0.15 per NFT Unit (the “Offering”).   Each NFT Unit will be comprised of one common share and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (a “NFT Warrant”). Each whole NFT Warrant is exercisable to purchase one common share at a price of $0.30 per share for a period of two years expiring November 23, 2028. If, at any time after four months and one day following the closing date of the Offering, the closing price of the Company's common shares on the TSX Venture Exchange (the “TSXV”) is equal to or greater than $0.40 per share for 10 consecutive trading days, the Company may, by notice to the holders of the NFT Warrants (which notice may be given by way of a general news release), accelerate the expiry date of the NFT Warrants to a date that is not less than 30 days following the date of such notice.

raw.text: Pinnacle Silver & Gold Corp (TSX-V:PINN, OTCQB:PSGCF) has closed the first tranche of its non-brokered private placement, raising gross proceeds of $420,985.  The first tranche consisted of 3.83 million units priced at $0.11 each.

raw.title: Pinnacle Closes First Tranche of Private Placement
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - November 19, 2026 - (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that it has closed a first tranche of a non-brokered private placement (the “Offering”) for gross proceeds of $420,985.00.   The first tranche consisted of 3,827,136 units (the "Units") with each Unit, priced at $0.11, comprising one common share (“Share”) in the capital of the Company and one-half share purchase warrant ("Warrant").  Each whole Warrant shall be convertible into an additional Share at an exercise price of $0.16 for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.  No Finders' Fees were paid in connection with the Offering. The Offering will consist of up to a total of 10,000,000 units (the "Units") with each Unit, priced at $0.11, comprising one common share (“Share”) in the capital of the Company and one-half share purchase warrant ("Warrant").  Each whole Warrant shall be convertible into an additional Share at an exercise price of $0.16 for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.  The Company is seeking to raise gross proceeds of up to $1,100,000, of which $420,985.00 has already been raised in tranche one.

raw.text: JPMorgan has named Unilever PLC (LSE:ULVR), British American Tobacco PLC (LSE:BATS) and Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC (LSE:RKT, OTCQX:RBGLY) among its top European consumer staples picks for 2027, citing their potential to deliver earnings growth despite rising cost pressures. The bank expects the sector to face a more challenging operating environment next year, with muted demand in the US and Europe, less consistent emerging markets growth and tougher comparatives.

raw.title: Tech meltdown sparks flight to defensive stocks as Unilever, Reckitt and Diageo rally
raw.text: Investors piled into defensive UK stocks on Wednesday as a global technology sell-off prompted a flight towards established consumer businesses, lifting shares in Unilever, Reckitt Benckiser and Diageo. Consumer goods giant Unilever PLC (LSE:ULVR) climbed 1.92% to 5,050p, while household products group Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC (LSE:RKT, OTCQX:RBGLY) gained 1.86% to 5,815p.

raw.title: Safe-haven stocks dominate the risers as London traders go into risk-off mode
raw.text: Defensive stocks dominated the FTSE 100's biggest gainers on Friday as London investors sought shelter from a global sell-off in technology shares and growing concerns over artificial intelligence valuations. raw.title: KON-16, Angola: Completion of Transaction
raw.text: Sintana Energy Inc. (TSX-V:SEI)(AIM:SEI)(OTCQX:SEUSF) ("Sintana" or the "Company") is pleased to announce completion of the acquisition of an indirect interest in the Block KON-16 in the onshore Kwanza Basin in Angola, pursuant to definitive agreements whose execution was announced on 10 September 2026. Following completion, Sintana holds an indirect 5% participating interest in KON-16.

raw.title: Sintana Energy completes deal to join Angola project ahead of well drilling
raw.text: Sintana Energy Inc (TSX-V:SEI, OTCQB:SEUSF, AIM:SEI) announced it has completed a US$2.5 million deal for an indirect 5% stake in Angola's KON-16 block, where partner Corcel aims to drill an exploration well in 2027. Sintana paid US$2 million on completion, following an initial US$500,000 payment to Corcel in May 2025.

raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SNOWLINE GOLD CORP. (TSX: SGD) (US OTCQB: SNWGF) (the “Company” or “Snowline”) is pleased to announce additional drill results from its 2026 exploration program, including discovery of widespread gold mineralization at its Duke target, a reduced-intrusion related gold system (“RIRGS”) located 12 km southeast of the Company's flagship Valley gold deposit on its 100% owned Rogue Project (Figure 5). Drillhole DUK-26-004 intersected 1.03 g/t Au over 65.8 m, including a 1.0 m interval at 32.20 g/t Au (Table 1), while DUK-26-005, collared 675 m to the northeast, intersected 9.0 m averaging 1.12 g/t Au within a broader zone of mineralization (Table 2). At Valley, infill hole V-26-165 returned 450.2 m averaging 1.47 g/t Au from surface, including 210.5 m at 2.07 g/t Au, outperforming the Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”) block model. The hole ended with an additional 44.3 m intersection averaging 0.72 g/t Au (Table 2) in an otherwise untested area at depth to the northeast of the main deposit (Figure 7).

raw.title: Trident Announces Strategic Investment by Alamos Gold
raw.text: Highlights Strategic investment by Alamos Gold for approximately 15% of Trident's common shares at a premium price Up to $33.1 million gross proceeds to accelerate exploration at The Contact Lake Gold Project and further establish the La Ronge gold belt as Canada's next significant gold camp Through a joint Technical Committee between Trident and Alamos, Trident will leverage Alamos' deep exploration and development expertise in Canada Vancouver, British Columbia, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Trident Resources Corp. (TSXV: ROCK) (OTCQB: TRDTF) (“Trident” or the “Company”) announces that it has entered into a subscription agreement with Alamos Gold Inc. (TSX:AGI) (NYSE: AGI) (“Alamos”) in respect of a strategic investment whereby Alamos has agreed to purchase on a non-brokered private placement basis 2,870,000 common shares of the Company (“Common Shares”) at a price of $3.49 for aggregate gross proceeds of $10,016,300 (the “Alamos Subscription Agreement”) and the Company will be completing a non-brokered private placement of up to 4,550,000 “flow-through shares” sold to charitable purchasers at an average price of $5.09 for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $23,159,500, with Alamos as the back-end purchaser of the Common Shares issued as “flow-through shares” (the Alamos Subscription Agreement together with the “flow-through share” offering, the “Offering”). The Offering is expected to result in Alamos owning approximately 15% of the issued and outstanding Common Shares.

raw.title: Laurion Announces Proposed Private Placement of Flow-Through Units
raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - November 25 , 2026 – LAURION Mineral Exploration Inc. (TSX.V: LME|OTC: LMEFF|FSE: 5YD) (“LAURION” or the “Corporation”) today announced that it is proposing to complete a flow-through private placement on a non-brokered basis (the “ Private Placement ”). The Corporation intends to raise up to approximately $ 1.5 million in gross proceeds by issuing up to approximately 14,285,714 “flow through” units (“ FT Units ”) at a price of $0.105 per FT Unit. Each FT Unit will consist of one common share of the Corporation to be issued as a “flow-through share” (as defined in subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada) (the “ Tax Act ”)) and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (each whole warrant, a “ Warrant ”). Each Warrant will entitle the holder thereof to acquire one non flow-through common share of the Corporation at a price of $0.18 per share for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.

raw.title: Rokmaster Announces Flow-Through Non-Brokered Private Placement
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 24, 2026) - Rokmaster Resources Corp. (TSXV: RKR) (OTCQB: RKMSF) (FSE: 1RR1) ("Rokmaster" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has arranged a non-brokered private placement with a subscriber involving the sale of 6,000,000 units (the "Units") at a price of $0.05 per Unit to raise total gross proceeds of $300,000 (the "Offering"). Each Unit will consist of one flow-through common share of the Company (a "Unit Share", and each common share of the Company, a "Common Share") and one-half of one non-transferable Common Share purchase warrant (each full warrant, a "Warrant"), with each Warrant being exercisable to acquire one additional Common Share (non-flow-through) for a period of 24 months from closing at an exercise price of $0.075 per share.

raw.title: Pinnacle Closes First Tranche of Private Placement
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - November 19, 2026 - (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that it has closed a first tranche of a non-brokered private placement (the “Offering”) for gross proceeds of $420,985.00.   The first tranche consisted of 3,827,136 units (the "Units") with each Unit, priced at $0.11, comprising one common share (“Share”) in the capital of the Company and one-half share purchase warrant ("Warrant").  Each whole Warrant shall be convertible into an additional Share at an exercise price of $0.16 for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.  No Finders' Fees were paid in connection with the Offering. The Offering will consist of up to a total of 10,000,000 units (the "Units") with each Unit, priced at $0.11, comprising one common share (“Share”) in the capital of the Company and one-half share purchase warrant ("Warrant").  Each whole Warrant shall be convertible into an additional Share at an exercise price of $0.16 for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.  The Company is seeking to raise gross proceeds of up to $1,100,000, of which $420,985.00 has already been raised in tranche one.

raw.title: Ventripoint Diagnostics Announces Placement of Two VMS+™ Systems for Clinical Deployment
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire - November 1 9, 2026 - Ventripoint Diagnostics Ltd. (" Ventripoint " or the " Company "), (TSXV:VPT; OTC:VPTDF) is pleased to announce the sale of two VMS+™ cardiac imaging systems, which will be donated in honor of Ella's Umbrella. The systems will support clinical research and the integration of advanced cardiac imaging into routine patient care. One placement is planned to support a study involving pregnant women with congenital heart disease (CHD). Advances in the diagnosis and treatment of congenital heart conditions, together with improvements in surgical and interventional procedures, have enabled more patients with CHD to survive and live longer lives. As this population ages, patients increasingly encounter life events and medical conditions, including pregnancy, that can place additional demands on the heart. These circumstances create a growing need for accessible, accurate and comprehensive cardiac assessment to support clinical decision-making and patient management.

raw.title: Rocket Doctor AI Announces Resignation of Chief Financial Officer
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rocket Doctor AI Inc. ( CSE: AIDR , OTC: AIRDF , Frankfurt: 939 ) (“Rocket Doctor AI” or the “Company”) announces the resignation of Andrew Lau as Chief Financial Officer of the Company, for personal reasons effective November 24, 2026. The Company would like to thank Mr. Lau for his efforts and contributions to the Company. The Company may engage Mr. Lau on a consulting basis in the future. “Andrew has been a valued member of our executive leadership team and has played an important role in strengthening our financial operations and supporting our growth initiatives. We fully support his decision to step down for personal reasons and wish him all the best in his future endeavors,” said Dr. Essam Hamza, Chief Executive Officer of Rocket Doctor AI Inc.

raw.title: Rocket Doctor and a Leading Canadian Pharmacy Chain Launch Digital Healthcare Pilot Across 25 Canadian Pharmacy Locations
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rocket Doctor AI Inc. ( CSE: AIDR , OTC: AIRDF , Frankfurt: 939 ) (“Rocket Doctor AI” or the “Company”) today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Rocket Doctor Inc. (“Rocket Doctor”), has launched an initial 90-day pilot program with a leading Canadian pharmacy chain to expand access to physician-led digital care through 25 participating pharmacy locations across Canada, beginning in Alberta, British Columbia and Ontario. The 90-day pilot program offers pharmacy customers a streamlined pathway to easily connect with Canadian medical professionals via Rocket Doctor's digital health platform. By providing participating pharmacies access to its software, patient care coordinators, and AI technology, Rocket Doctor simplifies patient navigation for comprehensive primary and urgent care services. “Community pharmacies are among the most accessible anchors of Canada's healthcare system, deeply embedded across even our most rural and remote regions. Partnering with them creates a natural bridge to connect patients with physicians right where they are, when they need care most,” said Dr. William Cherniak, Co-Founder and CEO of Rocket Doctor Inc. “By pairing a nationwide pharmacy network with Rocket Doctor's digital platform, we offer a seamless pathway that supports and elevates community pharmacists, including those operating under an expanded scope who wish to collaborate with physicians in a truly integrated, team-based care model.” As part of the initiative, Rocket Doctor may also provide select pharmacies with bluetooth-enabled smart medical devices, including digital stethoscopes, blood pressure cuffs, digital otoscopes, thermometers and pulse oximeters to support virtual consultations. The partnership is designed to complement the role of community pharmacies while preserving patient choice and professional judgment. Where prescriptions are appropriate following a consultation with a physician on Rocket Doctor, patients will have the opportunity to have their prescriptions filled through their preferred pharmacy. Launched in October 2026, the pilot program will initially run for 90 days. Following this period, the pharmacy chain will evaluate participating locations based on key performance metrics, including utilization, engagement, commercial results and other agreed performance criteria, to determine whether to expand the program across potentially hundreds of additional locations for a full one-year term. This initiative reflects Rocket Doctor's strategy to combine in-person and virtual care by partnering with established healthcare organizations across North America to expand access to physician-led services. Integrating digital health technology with trusted community locations helps patients, particularly in remote and underserved areas, connect with medical professionals. The platform also equips physicians with the tools and infrastructure required for efficient delivery of care, including ordering labs and imaging, writing specialist referrals, and scheduling follow-up appointments to ensure comprehensive, longitudinal care.

raw.title: Cowboy State Mine Prefeasibility Study Delivers NPV Uplift and Maiden Ore Reserve
raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Prefeasibility Study outcome: after tax NPV of approximately US$1.3B at an 8% real discount rate and after-tax IRR of 24% for Cowboy State Mine, with pre-production capital of US$840M including contingency Value upside under way: recovery optimisation with Novex has commenced, and each one percentage point increase in NdPr recovery adds approximately US$50 million to NPV⁸ Greater definition and confidence: capital and operating costs estimated to ±25% accuracy, with contingency of 15% of direct capital compared with the 2026 Scoping Study accuracy of ±30-50% with contingency of 30% Long life domestic supply: mining and processing of 4.5 million tonnes per annum over 26 years, with average annual NdPr oxide production of approximately 2,500 tonnes, scheduled entirely from Probable Ore Reserves Maiden Ore Reserve: Probable Ore Reserve of 116.4 million tonnes at 1,257 ppm payable rare earth oxide (PREO) declared at Cowboy State Mine Feasibility Study advancing: drilling to convert Mineral Resources to Ore Reserves for the Feasibility Study is complete, with yttrium being assessed as a future product opportunity DENVER, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- American Rare Earths Limited (ASX: ARR | OTCQX: ARRNF | ADR: AMRRY) (“ARR” or “the Company”) is pleased to announce the results of the Prefeasibility Study (“PFS”) for Cowboy State Mine (“CSM”), the first development phase of the Halleck Creek Project in Wyoming, together with the declaration of a maiden Probable Ore Reserve. The PFS evaluates a 4.5 million tonne per annum open pit operation over 26 years, with estimated after tax NPV of approximately US$1.3B at an 8% real discount rate and pre-production capital of approximately US$840M, including contingency.

raw.text: We reiterate Buy on PDD Holdings and Sell on Alibaba Group Holding, favoring PDD's stronger fundamentals amid geopolitical and AI uncertainty. As of Q3 2026, BABA's $25.95B CapEx drove negative $11.81B free cash flow, while PDD generated $16.29B operating cash flow with just $170.74M CapEx. BABA also trades at a large premium (12.45x FWD P/E) relative to PDD (7.78x) despite PDD's better profitability and operation metrics.

raw.title: Alibaba: AI Monetization Accelerates, Export Control Does Not Reset The Bullish Thesis
raw.text: Alibaba remains our top pick: accelerating cloud monetization supports the bullish thesis despite elevated AI spending and export-control uncertainty. BABA's AI-related revenue surpassed $10 billion in annualized run rate, while external recurring cloud revenue grew 67% year over year. Export controls temper cloud growth and accelerate domestic chip investment, with free cash flow generation deferred until the second half of 2028.

raw.title: Alibaba: 50%+ Cloud Growth, 9.1x P/E, Oversold
raw.text: Alibaba delivered better-than-expected top-line results for Q2 '27, with cloud and generative AI adoption offsetting sluggish e-commerce growth. Cloud grew roughly 5 times faster than Alibaba's consolidated revenues, firmly establishing the segment as a growth engine. BABA trades at 9.1x forward earnings, reflecting concerns about ownership structures, transparency, and potential politically motivated intervention from Beijing.

raw.title: Alibaba Down 38% Since My Sell Call: Earnings May Not Change The Story
raw.text: Alibaba Group Holding Limited's China eCommerce revenue fell 8% last quarter, and even excluding accounting changes, the core business funding its AI bet is flat at best. CapEx grew 75%, and free cash flow was a ~$6.6 billion outflow, while AI Labs losses more than quadrupled, and quick commerce only targets profitability in fiscal 2029. Without access to cutting-edge U.S. chips, I think Alibaba's AI CapEx cannot earn the same returns as its Western peers.

$BVAXF $BIOV.CSE Quick context on PESCO. The 40% ORR is for platinum-sensitive ovarian patients. Overall the ORR was 24%, with an 82% disease control rate.

It’s small and open-label, so I’d call it a signal. Filings are still the gate for the stock.
